messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] INC-3987 — spike in 5xx on /v1/generate (eu-west). p99 latency up, 5xx rate ~9% over last 3m. paging primary oncall. :rotating_light:

maria: seeing it in dashboards. errors are mostly 502/504, not app-level 500. looks like upstream timeout to prim-sec KVS cluster.

aj: confirmed logs show repeated `upstream request timeout` from token-storage-proxy. 2 of 6 primsec pods returning 503s.

vikas: rolling back last deploy? who deployed to token-storage-proxy in the last hour?

maria: deploys show a config change for `kv_client.timeout_ms` bumped to 12000 45m ago by ci-pipeline. rolling back to previous 5000 fixed earlier flakiness but maybe not this.

sophia: load has a long tail — p95 requests are fine but p99s spike. cache miss rate jumped on eu-west primaries.

aj: mitigation steps I'm taking now: 1) divert traffic to secondary KV cluster for eu-west read path; 2) increase token-store connection pool; 3) enable aggressive prefetch for active keys.

maria: note for handoff — primary: aj (now), secondary: vikas. aj, please post exact commands and current state before handing off.

aj: command to route reads (internal router):
```
POST https://router.internal/reroute
{ "service": "token-store", "region": "eu-west", "target": "kv-secondary", "traffic_pct": 100 }
```
Executed at ~T+3m. Response: 202 accepted. Verified by router logs: `route-change id=rc_1001 status=applied`.

eng-sre-bot: Automated check — reroute applied, active connections to kv-b-primary reduced from 4200 -> 400. Health check for kv-secondary: 12/12 passing.

vikas: I'm seeing decreased 5xx on the API gateway after reroute. p50/p95 stable, p99 still a little high (due to a few long-running regen jobs).

maria: customer impact: partial — some customers experienced failures on long generation (>1200 tokens). Most short calls succeeded. Support tickets: 3 P2s opened (EU accounts), CS notified.

sophia: temporary mitigation I applied: lowered max_request_length to 500 for public route `/v1/generate` in eu-west to shed tail. This reduces feature exposure but improves success rate. Patch: feature-flag `eu_west_tail_shed=true`.

aj: monitoring checks I added:
- flux alert: 5xx rate > 5% for 5m -> pager
- regen-run-time alert: job duration > 60s -> digest
- kv-miss-rate: alert if miss rate > 20%

maria: runbook pointers: see https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction-triage and https://redwood.internal/playbooks/late-tail-shedding. If you need to rollback config: run `rb-deploy token-storage-proxy --to=previous` and verify by describing pods.

vikas: ongoing tasks for next shift:
- validate router capacity under reroute, ensure secondary not saturating (check `router.metrics.qps` every 5m)
- run `kv-compact` on kv-secondary off-peak if miss rate stays > 15%
- follow up with infra for `socket timeout` dig on primaries (ticket INF-1212)

aj: state summary for handoff:
- Incident INC-3987 active, severity: Sev2 (partial customer impact)
- Mitigations applied: traffic reroute to kv-secondary (eu-west), decreased max_request_length on public route, increased connection pool, alerts tightened
- Current impact: 5xx rate down from 9% -> 1.8% in 10m window, p99 latency still elevated (~2.3s)
- Next steps: monitor for 30m, keep secondary under 80% CPU, escalate to infra if socket timeouts persist

maria: coverage notes — next oncall window (overnight EU) coverage gap between 02:00-03:00 UTC if no swap is scheduled. vikas please confirm if you can extend until 03:30 UTC or hand to sophia earlier.

vikas: I can extend to 03:30 UTC. I'll also create a short runbook snippet in case of reversion:
```
- check router change: `GET /router/changes/rc_1001`
- if secondary saturating: `POST /router/reroute { "target": "kv-primary", "traffic_pct": 50 }` then do gradual rollback
- if persistent socket errors: escalate to infra oncall (pager: infra-oncall) with logs and `strace` output
```

sophia: I'll watch dashboards from 00:30 UTC and be ready to take over if anything flares. I'll also patch the feature-flag to false if latency doesn't improve in next 40m.

aj: support/customer comms: CS notified and mentioned mitigating steps. Ask CS to update customers in affected EU orgs that we mitigated and are monitoring; promise follow-up postmortem.

maria: ok handoff to vikas in 20m. please keep thread updated with any new alerts or if 5xx creeps back above 3%. Use `inc-update` with timestamps and summary.

oncall-bot: Reminder: add post-incident follow-up task to INC-3987: include root-cause analysis, deploy audit, and mitigation timeline. Assign to aj + infra.

vikas: acknowledged. taking primary at handoff_ts=3398765460. leaving this thread open and will post final status before shift end. :white_check_mark:
